title: Wheel Response V2.0
description: A Data Type representing the measured state and condition of a specific wheel of the Connected Autonomous Vehicle in response to a steering command.

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) associated with this Wheel Response instance.

WheelResponseID.description: Unique identifier of this Wheel Response instance.

WheelID.description: Identifier of the wheel reporting the response.

WheelResponseTime.description: Time this Wheel Response instance was produced.

WheelResponse.description: Set of measured wheel response parameters.

WheelAngle.description: Measured steering angle in degrees (–90 to +90).

SteeringRate.description: Measured angular steering rate in degrees per second.

ActuatorLoad.description: Estimated steering actuator load or torque (Nm).

AnomalyFlags.description: Anomaly flags indicating fault conditions of the steering actuator.

MechanicalStopProximity.description: Indicates proximity to the mechanical steering stop.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal, security, and confidence information associated with this Wheel Response instance in a trusted data exchange context.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Wheel Response instance (plain text, max 2048 characters).
